title: citrus decumana var. paradisi
intro: Citrus decumana var. paradisi, commonly known as the grapefruit, is a hybrid plant species that combines the pomelo (Citrus maxima) and the orange (Citrus sinensis). The health benefits of grapefruit include reducing cholesterol levels, aiding in weight loss, and improving insulin sensitivity, which can be beneficial for people with type 2 diabetes. The therapeutic actions of grapefruit include its ability to act as a natural stimulant, improving digestion, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of grapefruit include flavonoids, limonoids, and furanocoumarins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
